//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Quick Right-Click -> Config

Enable Quick Right-Click.//: Whether Quick Right-Click is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

enableQuickBeds.//: If right-clicking beds in the air should enable the quick feature.

enableQuickCartographyTables.//: If right-clicking cartography tables in the air should enable the quick feature.

enableQuickCraftingTables.//: If right-clicking crafting tables in the air should enable the quick feature.

enableQuickEnderChests.//: If right-clicking ender chests in the air should enable the quick feature.

enableQuickGrindstones.//: If right-clicking grindstones in the air should enable the quick feature.

enableQuickShulkerBoxes.//: If right-clicking shulker boxes in the air should enable the quick feature.

enableQuickSmithingTables.//: If right-clicking smithing tables in the air should enable the quick feature.

enableQuickStonecutters.//: If right-clicking stonecutters in the air should enable the quick feature.
